description: One control meeting one framework criterion. Criteria travel by id alone, so no framework's text is ever in a file.

criterion.description: The framework's own id, exactly, such as CC6.1 or PR.AA-03. Never the criterion's text.

id.description: <control id>-<framework>-<criterion slug>, such as mfa-soc2-cc6-1. The criterion slug is the criterion lowercased, with every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 made one hyphen and hyphens trimmed from both ends. When two mappings would share an id, each takes -h and the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of <control id>, a newline, <framework>, a newline and the exact criterion (UTF-8), so an id never depends on which other mappings exist.

source_fields.description: The source's own fields that no field here covers, under the source's names. Readers keep it and don't interpret it. Never a personal value that a field here would label.
